note: Characters missing from OpenCC TSCharacters, or left unchanged by it, that this edition uses as traditional or variant forms. Applied to quote text and to snapshots after the phrase table, TSPhrases, and TSCharacters. 乾 is not in this table; it stays 乾. 愼 maps to 慎. 茍 (U+830D) is not a variant of 苟 and is not in this table. The phrase 終食之閒 (snapshot U+9592; also written 终食之閎) becomes 终食之间. 閒, 閎, and 閑 are not globally mapped to 间, so 大德不踰閑 stays 闲.
